text:
samantha_ops: quick one 914 - I'm going on parental leave 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-01 and saw the 401k vendor is migrating to Forus next month. If contributions transfer while I'm out, will my pre-tax deferrals and employer match carry over? Also I contribute to an HSA via payroll pretax - will that be interrupted?

rachel_benefits: hey @samantha_ops :wave: short answers up front: 1) contributions made while you're on unpaid leave won't be taken (so no deferrals -> no match). 2) balances in the old 401k trustee will be transferred to the new vendor for active accounts per the migration; your existing vested balance transfers regardless of LOA. 3) HSA payroll contributions are tied to payroll runs; if you're unpaid they stop. you can continue contributing to your HSA via after-tax personal contributions and then claim an adjustment if allowed by the HSA custodian, but that's outside payroll.

dan-payroll: adding payroll detail 4c5 - migration timeline: final payroll cutoff to the old trustee is payroll on 2026-04-30. New vendor accepts records from 2026-05-15. if you're unpaid and have no earnings between those dates, no deferrals will process. employer match is calculated on wages paid during the plan year; match for missed pay periods won't be auto-recreated.

forus-rep: hi team 44b - Forus migration specialist here. Confirming: we'll do a trustee-to-trustee transfer of balances and standard participant record import. For participants with active loans, loan balance transfers but repayment mechanisms may change (we'll contact each borrower). For catch-up or manual contributions, we can accept an "after-the-fact" contribution file if plan admin approves and IRS limits aren't exceeded.

samantha_ops: thanks. Is there anything I need to sign while on leave to accept the transfer or to enable loan ACH if I won't have payroll?

rachel_benefits: good Q - typically no signature to accept the trustee transfer for balances. For loan ACHs or one-time vendor contributions we need a signed ACH authorization or a one-time contribution form. we can e-sign while you're remote.

dan-payroll: practical steps: 1) if you want to keep loan payments, DM me and we4e8 I'll send the ACH auth template; 2) if you want to attempt a vendor catch-up for missed deferrals, tell rachel the gross amount you want to try to apply and we'll submit to Forus for acceptance; 3) if you plan to make HSA personal contributions, keep receipts for tax reporting.

forus-rep: sample email we'll send to participants with next steps: ```Subject: Forus migration - participant actions
Hello <Name>,
We will transfer your account balance on 2026-05-15. No action required to move balances. If you want ACH for loan payments or to submit a one-time contribution, please complete these forms: 1) ACH Authorization; 2) One-Time Contribution Form; 3) Signature Consent. Return to transfers@forus.example by 2026-05-10.```

leave-coordinator-bot: Helpful doc: https://benefits.redwood.example/migrations-2026 (see "Participant Actions & LOA")

samantha_ops: ok I'll DM the dates and request ACH if needed. Also can you confirm whether an employer-paid match accrues for unpaid FMLA-protected leave? I'm under state leave that may be paid partially.

rachel_benefits: FMLA is complicated: federal FMLA itself doesn't require employer match during unpaid leave; company policy or state laws may provide different treatment. If you receive any paid wages (including state disability or partial pay) and those are run through payroll as eligible compensation, they generally count for match. we'll verify with legal and the benefits vendor for your specific state.

dan-payroll: final note - managers/people ops: if someone's LOA overlaps vendor migration, flag the person in the LOA tracker so we can coordinate ACH and loan notices. saves headaches later. :thumbsup:

samantha_ops: thanks all, appreciate the clarity. I'll send the ACH form tomorrow and flag if I want the catch-up.
